name: WhatsApp Assistant
summary: Local WhatsApp MCP server and agent plugin with a graphical UI preview for Codex on macOS, selected text/media and separately confirmed replies, plus an opt-in private personal-Dot pilot through Secure MCP Tunnel.

release.scope: 0.3.0 UI preview and private Dot pilot; local browser-panel reads and private ChatGPT status/search/read/preparation verified; real sending confirmed by the operator on 2026-10-03; native UI support, reboot recovery and public hosting remain unverified

clientSupport.codex: primary target; 0.3.0 fresh local plugin installation, browser-panel rendering, connection and selected text read verified; native UI and real UI send unverified

requirements.client: local Codex, Claude Code or compatible stdio MCP client

suitableFor: Finding an intentionally selected existing WhatsApp chat
Summarizing selected recent text using the chosen AI client
Drafting a text reply and sending only after a new explicit recipient/text confirmation
Separately preauthorized narrowly scoped scheduled text sends
unsuitableFor: Official WhatsApp Business Platform integration or vendor-supported critical delivery
Bulk outreach, new-number sends or incoming-triggered automatic replies
Model-facing media downloads, calls or full-history archives
Windows/Linux runtime installation or cloud-only operation without a user-owned WhatsApp host
Offline AI or a promise that requested data never reaches an AI provider
limitations: Text reads are selected-chat, paginated and bounded to the last 30 days; incomplete history is reported
Unofficial OpenWA/WhatsApp Web integration may break or lead to account restrictions

The UI adapter listens only on loopback; the separate private Dot pilot uses the official Secure MCP Tunnel and has no public production endpoint. Chrome connects to WhatsApp; selected text-tool data and explicitly selected UI content enter the chosen AI context
The host cannot cryptographically prove human confirmation or scheduler origin; bearer capabilities remain sensitive
GitHub source distribution only; packages remain private, not an npm-installed product
Own source MIT does not relicense OpenWA or other dependencies

evidence.automatedTests: 153 local Node tests, 83 online tests and 24 installed security-fork regression cases passed on 2026-10-03; 16 synthetic Chrome browser cases passed on 2026-10-02 and initial hosted UI/source jobs passed. Attachment staging, account/digest binding, one-time approval, durable send reservations and uncertain outcomes covered. Two newly reported runtime advisories repaired with transparent local forks, full source inventories and unchanged production audit; strict release check and isolated frozen runtime installation pass. Fresh hosted checks for the repaired source remain separate
evidence.liveAcceptance: 0.3.0 fresh local plugin installation and Codex browser-panel rendering verified. Selected text read, names and one incoming image checked without exporting private content. Synthetic PNG/document preparation and exact-file confirmation verified without upload/send. Private ChatGPT tunnel status/search/read/preparation verified. On 2026-10-03 the operator confirmed successful real sending in personal use; no additional agent send or independent recipient receipt check. Native Codex MCP-App rendering, media delivery and reboot recovery remain unverified. Historical 0.2.0 evidence remains in CLIENT_ACCEPTANCE.md
